# monero_wallet_cli

> Headless Monero wallet for monero_wallet_backend: open or create a wallet, read the balance and addresses, build a transfer, review it and broadcast or withdraw it, all over `logosctl call`. Holds the custodian and approver roles, so a bare CLI (the host anchor) can do none of it.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `status() -> tstr` | `{ ok, held, custodian, approver, identity, approvers, custodians, awaiting, hint }`. |
| `open_wallet` | `open_wallet(name: tstr, password: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `create_wallet` | `create_wallet(name: tstr, password: tstr, label: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `restore_from_seed` | `restore_from_seed(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `restore_from_keys` | `restore_from_keys(params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `change_password` | `change_password(old_password: tstr, new_password: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `reveal_seed` | `reveal_seed(password: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `reveal_view_key` | `reveal_view_key(password: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `set_active_network` | `set_active_network(network: tstr) -> tstr` | CUSTODIAN. |
| `close_wallet` | `close_wallet() -> tstr` | Either role. |
| `prepare_send` | `prepare_send(send_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Build a send for review: `{ address, amountXmr ¦ amount, priority?, accountIndex? }` as one quoted document. |
| `transfer` | `transfer(address: tstr, amount_xmr: tstr) -> tstr` | `transfer <address> <amount>` — prepare_send without writing a JSON document by hand. |
| `show` | `show(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | The block a human reads for one previewed send, plus the backend's status. |
| `confirm` | `confirm(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | APPROVER: broadcast the previewed send. |
| `cancel` | `cancel(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Withdraw an unbroadcast send. |
| `list` | `list() -> tstr` | `{ ok, sends: [{ requestId, state }] }`. |
| `send_status` | `send_status(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `job_status` | `job_status(job_id: tstr) -> tstr` | `{ ok, state: queued¦running¦done¦failed, result?, error? }` for a lifecycle job id. |
| `wallet_status` | `wallet_status() -> tstr` |  |
| `list_wallets` | `list_wallets() -> tstr` |  |
| `list_networks` | `list_networks() -> tstr` |  |
| `balances` | `balances(account_index: int) -> tstr` |  |
| `receive_info` | `receive_info(account_index: int) -> tstr` | The primary address and every subaddress of an account. |
| `address_new` | `address_new(account_index: int, label: tstr) -> tstr` | `address new [<label>]` — derive a fresh subaddress on the account. |
| `history` | `history() -> tstr` |  |
| `address_valid` | `address_valid(address: tstr) -> bool` |  |
| `format_xmr` | `format_xmr(atomic: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `parse_xmr` | `parse_xmr(xmr: tstr) -> tstr` |  |
| `caller_identity` | `caller_identity() -> tstr` |  |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | `prompt(request_id: tstr, text: tstr)` | A send reached `previewed`. |
| `settled` | `settled(request_id: tstr, state: tstr)` | `sent` ¦ `failed` ¦ `cancelled` — the request left the awaiting set. |
| `queue_changed` | `queue_changed(count: int)` |  |
